'''Tony Lutz''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Dantooine Regionals]] on 25 June 2000 with Kashyyyk Speeder Operatives, according to Joe Horbey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d939">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-dantooine-regional-6th-place-reportd939/ dantooine-regional-6th-place-report], DeckTech (joe "brangus" horbey, 26 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-dantooine-regional-6th-place-reportd939/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
